## Bearded Vulture (CR 1/2)

This largish bird has fluffy, pale gold feathers on its head and neck with black feathers sweeping down alongside its beak in a beard-like fringe. Its wings are feathered brown and its long, hooked beak is caked with carrion.  

**XP** 200  
N Medium animal  
**Init** +2; **Senses** carrion scent, low-light vision, scent; Perception +10  


**Defense**


**AC** 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 natural)  
**hp** 11 (1d8+3)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +4, **Will** +2; +4 vs. disease  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., fly 50 ft. (average)  
**Melee** bite +2 (1d6+1)  
**Special Attacks** bone-crushing beak  


**Statistics**


**Str** 12, **Dex** 15, **Con** 16, **Int** 2, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +0; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 14  
**Feats** Great Fortitude, Weapon Finesseb  
**Skills** Fly +7, Perception +10; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception  


**Special Abilities**



**Bone-Crushing Beak (Ex)** When a bearded vulture confirms a critical hit with its beak against a Medium or smaller creature, the target takes 2 points of Strength damage and 2 points of Dexterity damage (DC 13 Fort half), and until this ability damage is healed the target’s speed is also reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet) due to damage to its bones. Skeletal undead can be harmed by this ability. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Carrion Scent (Ex)** A bearded vulture’s scent ability allows it to sense the presence of creatures at 0 hit points or that are taking bleed damage at five times the normal range.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm mountains  
**Organization** solitary or pair  
**Treasure** incidental
